description: Issue an Agent Delegation Credential (SD-JWT VC) for a NEW agent: owner + local attestation authority keys from the vault, fresh agent did:key, revocation slot registered on the ledger. The credential and the agent private key are written to the operator-configured home directory; the result references them by path and never contains key material.

agent_name.description: Label for the new agent (also the artifact file prefix)

name: mandare_issue_passport
title: Issue an agent passport
